correctness.rationale: For every n>=7, coordinatewise triple-distance counting bounds the total of three binary pairwise distances by 2n; 3(n-2)>2n excludes all triangles, and antipodal/near-antipodal edges prove graph connectedness. For n=5,6, two exhaustive face enumerators agree; the complete oriented integer matrices for boundary_2 and its relative projection reduce by respectively (209,159) and (418,418) unit pivots to zero residual. Unique triangle carriers make boundary_3 injective. These verified exact integer operations certify ranks, torsion-freeness and, via the relative long exact sequence, the complete Smith forms of the degree-one inclusion maps. Every proof premise is covered by the packaged checker or the all-parameter counting proof. The exceptional cases claim homology, not homotopy.

value.rationale: The minimum Hamming-distance packing complex of the entire binary cube is a canonical anti-Rips object. The two thresholds directly below its metric diameter form a natural filtration. A dimension-five to dimension-six transition kills exactly 50 old integral H1 classes in one dimension and none thereafter, with all inclusion images primitive and exceptional H2 ranks 151 and 302. The threshold n>=7 is forced by the Plotkin triple bound, giving a complete infinite-family classification with motivated exceptional cases. This distinguishes anti-Rips persistence from ordinary Rips and is more than an isolated Euler-characteristic census.
